title: Link to Places docs?
body:
A user was looking for how to integrate Places into instantsearch.js and said this
"It might be nice if you linked to that more prominently within the instantsearch.js documentation."

in reference to https://community.algolia.com/places/documentation.html#instantsearchjs

What do you think of adding a link to the bottom of 'wrapping up' for those curious on how to integrate Places?
